title: release text: three pending changesets in the next 18.0.0 pre-release carry sentences that later same-release PRs make false (Hono currentRecord 'held'; the organization_id drop gate 'inventory only')
body:
Filing gate **①**, the release-text exception. `reach:` **release text.** Each file below is pending in `.changeset/` (`pre.json`: mode `pre`, tag `next`, 0 changesets consumed), so it compiles into the next release's CHANGELOGs beside the changeset that makes it false.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## The sentences

| Pending changeset | Sentence | Made false by |
|---|---|---|
| `.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-body.md:15` | "`currentRecord` is held on these two doors until #23586 settles how the protocol reads that row" | PR #23667 (`5bb9a83bd0`), whose `.changeset/23531-hono-conflict-current-record.md` says it supersedes this note |
| `.changeset/23587-hono-structured-arm-fields.md:14` | "`CONCURRENT_UPDATE`'s `currentRecord` stays held until #23586 settles how the protocol reads that row" | the same PR #23667 |
| `.changeset/23429-v18-boot-refusal.md:20` and `:27` | "refuses to drop `organization_id` from any table in the ceremony's inventory (the D7 tables and the `sys_metadata` family)"; "Only an `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` run that would drop an inventory table's `organization_id` is refused" | PR #23699 (#23684, in review at this stamp; the row stands once it lands): every `organization_id` drop the drift offers is held back, and its changeset's FROM / TO states the change |

## Why it was not fixed in those PRs

This seat kept each earlier changeset byte for byte in a code PR, as #15953 ruling B (`6133232470`) did for an earlier slice's unreleased changeset. Each superseding changeset states the change in its own FROM / TO. The result is two contradicting sentences in one release's notes, and a release editor must choose one story.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes it to whoever owns release-text review for the next 18.0.0 pre-release. The choice:
- **(a)** amend the three earlier changesets in one release-text PR, before the Version Packages PR consumes them;
- **(b)** leave them, and let the compiled notes carry both, the later one read as the update.

⛔ Not edited by this filing.

**Dedupe words:** pending changeset superseded same release; currentRecord held changeset; v18-boot-refusal inventory only; release text contradiction 18.0.0-next.
